Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring posting of staff levels at nursing homes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to posting staffing levels at nursing homes; andadding a new section to chapter 18.51 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.51 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each nursing home shall compile and post in a visible andaccessible location of the residential area information about thenumber and type of credentialed health care providers who are directlyresponsible for resident care during each shift. The information shallalso specify the anticipated ratio of credentialed health careproviders to residents during each shift. The information shall beadjusted within a reasonable amount of time after each shift has begunto reflect the actual staffing level and the actual ratio ofcredentialed health care providers to residents. (2) Each nursing home shall compile the monthly averages of theinformation listed in subsection (1) of this section by shift andreport it to the department every year at a time and manner prescribedby the department. In addition, the nursing home shall provide a copy p. 1 SB 6279of the report to any member of the public upon request. The departmentshall compile an annual report of the reports that it receives fromeach nursing home and make the information available to the public.
